title: Inspection image readings
description: The axis uses native frame positions, with frame 1 at 00:00:00 UTC and one display second per frame. These positions do not record capture time or sampling cadence. Measurements cover the complete caption on each original image.

list.name: edition
list.label: Recording
list.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inspection_frame" and r._field == "frame")
  |> group(columns: ["serial", "edition", "run_id"])
  |> first()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.serial + " · " + strings.replaceAll(v: r.run_id, t: "-", u: " ") + " · " + strings.substring(v: strings.split(v: r.edition, t: "~")[1], start: 0, end: 8) + "|" + r.edition}))
  |> group()
  |> sort()
list.definition:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inspection_frame" and r._field == "frame")
  |> group(columns: ["serial", "edition", "run_id"])
  |> first()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.serial + " · " + strings.replaceAll(v: r.run_id, t: "-", u: " ") + " · " + strings.substring(v: strings.split(v: r.edition, t: "~")[1], start: 0, end: 8) + "|" + r.edition}))
  |> group()
  |> sort()

panels.title: Caption brightness
panels.description: Mean caption brightness on the original 8-bit image. Frame 1 starts at display second zero; one display second represents one frame.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inspection_frame" and r.edition =~ /^${edition:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "caption_mean")
  |> group(columns: ["run_id","serial","edition"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value","run_id","serial","edition"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Caption contrast
panels.description: Population standard deviation of 8-bit luma across the same caption pixels. Horizontal position is the native frame number expressed in display seconds, starting at zero.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inspection_frame" and r.edition =~ /^${edition:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "caption_contrast")
  |> group(columns: ["run_id","serial","edition"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value","run_id","serial","edition"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Frame register
panels.description: UTC display origin: January 1, 2026. Frame positions are ordinal. Use the image hash and run edition to identify an archived frame.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inspection_frame" and r.edition =~ /^${edition:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frame" or r._field == "image_sha" or r._field == "caption_pixels")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["serial","run_id","frame"])
  |> keep(columns: ["frame","run_id","serial","revision","check_id","image_sha","caption_pixels","edition"])
